title: Research corpus intake (Phase 2)
description: Move the workflow research corpus into docs/research/ with frontmatter (provenance, status) and an index. Related: portfolio-agentic-engineering-zfyv. This is the lowest-coupling, highest-volume step of the separation plan and the reason this repository exists: the corpus would have burst portfolio's frame.

title: Carve the template slice from the kit (Phase 3.1)
description: Move templates/ and scripts/handover_schema.py from portfolio-agentic-engineering, and adopt the handover schema validation into this repository's gate list. First step of the mechanism migration; each migration step moves ownership completely and is measured with the Leerprobe (scripts/kit/probe.py).

title: Bootstrap: repository, tracker, separation plan
description: Created the private repository, bootstrapped the tracker with the explicit prefix coding-harness- (bd init --prefix), added tools/bd guardrails (version pin 1.1.2, blocked init/migrate/upgrade), the skeleton per the portfolio kit manifest's geruest_ordner, house AGENTS.md, README, and the bootstrap handover. Reference: docs/journal/handover/2026-09-16-coding-harness-bootstrap.md

title: Adopt the mechanism gates into ci.yml (Phase 3.2 and up)
description: As the validators and the kit arrive (migration steps 3.2-3.5), add their gates to this repository's single gate list. No ci.yml exists yet by design: an empty gate list would be a claim without content. One list, per repo - the portfolio ci.yml is the model, not a second enumeration.
